sentence: In buildDomainOverview and buildDomainDetail the loop variables edge/e iterate graph.edges (and stepEdges, a filter of it) where graph is KnowledgeGraph whose edges is GraphEdge[], and the code reads edge.source, e.target and edge.weight.

The node in filteredGraph.nodes.map is a GraphNode because filteredGraph is typed KnowledgeGraph | null (nodes: GraphNode[]), and it reads node.summary, node.complexity and node.tags into CustomNodeData.
In prepareLayout(graph: KnowledgeGraph) the loop variable edge iterates graph.edges, typed GraphEdge[], and reads edge.source and edge.target.
In KnowledgeNodeDetails, meta is assigned node.knowledgeMeta where node is GraphNode (knowledgeMeta?: KnowledgeMeta), and it reads meta.wikilinks and meta.content.

In DomainNodeDetails, meta is assigned node.domainMeta where node is GraphNode (domainMeta?: DomainMeta), and it reads meta.entities, meta.businessRules, meta.crossDomainInteractions and meta.entryPoint.
In KnowledgeNodeDetails and DomainNodeDetails the callback parameter e comes from graph.edges where graph is KnowledgeGraph (edges: GraphEdge[]), and it reads e.source and e.target.
In buildChatContext(graph: KnowledgeGraph), graph.project is declared ProjectMeta and the code reads graph.project.languages and graph.project.frameworks.
In getAuthCredential(auth: AuthResult | undefined), auth.auth is declared ModelAuth in AuthResult and the code reads auth.auth.apiKey and auth.auth.headers.
In _getRequiredRequestAuth, result is declared AuthResult | undefined whose auth property is ModelAuth, and the code reads result.auth.apiKey, result.auth.headers and result.auth.baseUrl.
In describeProvider(modelRuntime, provider: Provider), Provider from pi-ai models.ts declares readonly auth: ProviderAuth, and the code reads provider.auth.apiKey and provider.auth.oauth.

In registerNativeProvider(provider: Provider), with Provider imported from pi-ai and its auth typed ProviderAuth, the code reads provider.auth.oauth and provider.auth.apiKey (the sample config.oauth lines are on another type but these reads qualify).

In composeApiKeyAuth and composeOAuthAuth the parameter base is typed Provider | undefined (auth: ProviderAuth) and the code reads base?.auth.apiKey and base?.auth.oauth (the sample config.apiKey and config.oauth reads are on ModelsJsonProvider, but these qualify).

requests is ModelRouteRequest[] whose failed property is typed { model; thinkingLevel?; message: AssistantMessage }, and the test reads requests[1].failed?.message.errorMessage and requests[1].failed?.message.stopReason.
setup is ChatSetup from chatSetup(), whose faux is FauxProviderHandle with state: FauxProviderState, and the test reads setup.faux.state.callCount and setup.faux.state.deferredFetchCount.

setup is ChatSetup whose readonly faux is declared FauxProviderHandle, and the test reads setup.faux.setResponses (called) and setup.faux.state (the sample record?.state line is on another type but these reads qualify).

setup is ChatSetup whose faux is FauxProviderHandle with state: FauxProviderState, and the test reads setup.faux.state.callCount, setup.faux.state.cancelledDeferred and setup.faux.state.deferredFetchCount.

setup is ChatSetup whose faux is declared FauxProviderHandle, and the test reads setup.faux.getPendingResponseCount, setup.faux.setResponses and setup.faux.state (the sample task?.state line is on another type).
setup is ChatSetup whose faux is declared FauxProviderHandle, and the test reads setup.faux.setResponses and setup.faux.state.callCount.

In run(setup: ChatSetup, ...) and the tests, setup.faux is declared FauxProviderHandle and the code reads setup.faux.setResponses and setup.faux.state.callCount.
